_comment: Documented audio/output inspections. Each entry must state what was measured, how, by whom and when. analyze.py cites these with basis 'inspection'. Never add an entry without a reproducible command.

inspections.finding: The far-field excerpt is 11.7 dB quieter on average than the close-talk excerpt of the same meeting window, and Deepgram recognised 47 words in it versus 319 (85% fewer). Because Deepgram speaker segments are built from recognised words, unrecognised speech is scored as missed (91.0% missed on the far-field excerpt).
